meta.title: Budget Agent — a budget from your receipts
meta.description: Photograph your receipts: every line is read, sorted into categories and products, and turned into advice you can check. Goals, a shared household budget and trips with Polish per diem.

lead: Every line item read off the photo, sorted into categories and products, and turned into advice built from your own purchases — not generic tips.
free: Free while in beta. No card needed.

shoot.title: Shoot it
shoot.text: One photo, several overlapping ones for a long receipt, or forward the e-receipt by email.

check.title: Check what we read
check.text: Anything unclear is flagged for you rather than quietly guessed.

see.title: See where it went
see.text: Month-to-date spend by category and product, against a limit you set.

receipts.title: Every line, not just the total
receipts.text: The receipt is read line by line — name, quantity, price — and every line lands in a category. Long receipts can be shot in parts; e-receipts arrive by email; cash without a receipt is typed in.
points: Totals that don't add up are explained, not hidden
Foreign receipts converted at the NBP rate of their day
Your corrections are remembered for next time

spending.title: Where the money really goes
spending.text: The month by category, against your limit, and each product you buy across every shop — what it cost then and now, and where it is cheaper.
points: One product, however each shop prints it
Price history per product and shop
A mark when another shop sells it for less

goals.title: Advice built from your purchases
goals.text: Set a goal — spend less on eating out, save for a holiday, eat fewer sweets — and get advice that names what you actually buy, with what each change would save you.
points: Only suggestions it can point to in your receipts
A warning when the month is heading over
Advice you turn down is not repeated

household.title: One budget for the family
household.text: Invite your partner or family with a link: everyone keeps their own receipts, the household sees the shared month and its limit.
points: Mark a receipt private: its money counts, its details stay yours
A household limit beside your own

trips.title: Holidays and business trips
trips.text: A holiday gets its own budget and day-by-day story. A business trip stays out of your budget and is settled with the per diem under Polish rules, ready to hand in.
points: Receipts join a trip by their dates
Per diem at home and abroad, each day and meal itemised
Settlement as PDF with receipt photos, or CSV

goal.name: Spend less on eating out
goal.advice: Cook at home on weekdays instead of the 3 lunches at Pasta Bar

privacy: Receipt photos and their extracted data are encrypted at rest and visible only to you — and to your household, unless you mark a receipt private.

items.a: Yes, while the service is in beta. You need no card to sign up.
Printed receipts from any shop, photographed in one or several overlapping shots, and e-receipts forwarded by email. Receipts in other currencies are converted at the NBP rate of their date.

items.q: What if I paid in cash and have no receipt?
items.a: Type the expense in: what it was, when, how much and in which currency. It counts like any receipt.
Only you. If you share a household budget, its members see your receipts too — except those you mark private, whose money still counts in the shared total.

items.q: Does it work for business trips?
items.a: Yes. A business trip stays out of your own budget; the service works out the per diem under the Polish regulation, takes off meals provided and the advance, and gives you the settlement as PDF or CSV.
English, Ukrainian and Polish. Amounts can be in any currency you keep your budget in.

final.title: Start with one receipt
final.text: It takes a photo and a minute.
